items.description: Compensation for watch and cash taken in robbery
items.rationale: The reported robbery is covered away from home. Because the invoice bundles the watch and cash without a separable split, clause 7.1.10 applies the lower class ceiling of €500 to the whole line; the €10,000 away-from-home limit does not reduce it, and there is no deductible.

items.description: Translation and handling of police report
items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude report translation and claim handling, even when billed alongside covered compensation. No amount is payable; €1 is a placeholder.
